scope: Personal Wi-Fi SecretAgent recovery for existing system-owned or not-saved NetworkManager profiles. No enterprise provisioning, agent-owned vault, WPS or physical-hardware claim.

architecture.domain: NetworkCredentialRequestId and nonsecret NetworkCredentialRequest; NetworkPort.watch_credentials and consuming answer_credentials. Existing NetworkSnapshot stays unchanged.
architecture.adapter: Explicit NetworkManager.with_secret_agent enables one SecretAgent on the existing unique-owner-pinned system-bus connection. Bounded one-shot callbacks validate exact native profile path/current handle/UUID/rawSSID/security/flags/hints and retire on cancellation/removal/service/observer loss.
architecture.client: Generation-bound zeroizing form uses existing masked_input and semantic recipes. Credential answers use the existing controls lane independently of ordinary activation. No OS IO in views; no new framework policy.
architecture.persistence: Return credentials to the original GetSecrets call; never AddAndActivate for repair. NetworkManager retains secret-storage authority; no vault or profile-storage override is claimed.
